name: dory
description: Second brain for Claude Code: sessions become Obsidian notes, recalled at session start

vault.title: Vault folder
vault.description: The Obsidian vault dory writes into. Not in iCloud Drive, which offloads files. Unset: config.toml, else ~/Obsidian/dory-brain.

language.title: Note language
language.description: The language dory writes the notes in. Headings stay English. Another language: choose Other (config.toml) and set language in ~/.config/dory-brain/config.toml. Until you set it here, config.toml decides, else English.

model.title: Worker model
model.description: The model that turns ended sessions into notes. haiku uses far less of your usage limit, opus the most. Until you set it here, config.toml decides, else sonnet.

context.title: Context at session start
context.description: How much of the context window the session start may load: lean 5 %, balanced 10 %, rich 15 %. Until you set it here, config.toml decides, else lean.

context_window.title: Context window (tokens)
context_window.description: The smallest context window you work with, e.g. 1000000 for 1M windows. Unset: config.toml, else 200000.
